desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct a new string $T$ by concatenating $S$, a unique separator character (e.g., '$'), and the reverse of $S$.
Implement the KMP prefix function computation (compute $\pi$ array for $T$).
Determine the length of the longest palindromic prefix of $S$ using $\pi[-1]$.
Construct the result by appending the reverse of the non-palindromic suffix to $S$.
Print the resulting shortest palindrome to standard output.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Test with edge cases (e.g., single character, all same characters).
